delivery.qaSummary: 浏览器端全量验收(verify-4)以真实 Chrome 通过 Agent Browser 对 NocoBase『设备售后服务与巡检协同系统』逐项执行 B01–B16，全部 16 项通过。覆盖：多岗位登录与越权隔离(B01/B07/B08/B13)、增改与必填/重复反馈(B02/B10)、搜索筛选分页与详情刷新(B03)、完整工单状态流转与转派/取消校验(B04)、幂等不跳状态(B05)、PNG/PDF/DOCX/XLSX/PPTX 真实上传与内容预览下载及损坏/不支持提示(B06)、消息中心持久/跳转/已读/离线补齐(B09)、自动受理执行记录步骤与结果一致且 Retry 保留旧记录不重复通知(B11)、巡检计划受控触发/不重复/停用不产生(B12)、用户创建停用重启用与只读角色(B14)、中英文逐页含文件组件/错误反馈切换(B15)、服务助手未配置时准确提示(B16)。失败项 0。说明：本环境未配置外部 LLM 与外部通知测试服务，B16 的真实模型问答与外部通知实投标注为扩展场景未执行，未声称成功；B11 无受控失败注入入口，失败原因字段与每步 error 字段存在但无真实失败样例；B15 个别下拉当前值显示原始值(all/east)为次要显示瑕疵，不影响通过结论。仅通过真实浏览器操作与截图取证，未读取应用源码或数据库，未生成验收用文件(使用测试准备 fixtures)。

checks.title: 按草稿、提交、分派、处理、待确认、退回、再次处理、关闭跑通一张工单；验证转派/取消原因和关闭后的限制。
checks.criterion: 按草稿、提交、分派、处理、待确认、退回、再次处理、关闭跑通一张工单；验证转派/取消原因和关闭后的限制。
actions: 以主管登录，打开草稿工单 SR202609010005（East China），点击 Submit for dispatch 并确认，状态变为 Pending dispatch。
点击 Dispatch，展开 Assignee 选择器，选择李明 / Li Ming · East China 后确认，工单进入 In progress。
以被派工程师 svc.east@example.com（李明）登录，打开同一工单，点击 Log progress，填写处理说明与工时 2.5 并确认；再点击 Submit for confirmation 填写说明并提交，状态变为 Pending confirmation。
回到主管，点击 Return for rework，先直接确认（原因为空），再填写退回原因并确认，工单回到 In progress。
工程师再次 Log progress（工时 1）并 Submit for confirmation。
主管点击 Confirm and close，填写 Resolution 后确认，工单变为 Closed，并检查关闭后是否还有处理/转派/取消按钮。
主管打开 SR202609010014，点击 Transfer ticket，选择刘洋 / Liu Yang，先空备注确认，再填写备注确认。
主管打开草稿工单 SR202609010012，点击 Cancel ticket，先空原因确认，再填写原因确认。
evidence: 草稿提交：SR202609010005 执行 Submit for dispatch 后状态从 Draft → Pending dispatch。
派工：Dispatch 对话框 Assignee 仅列出 4 名工程师（李明、周洁、张伟、刘洋），选择李明后状态变 In progress 且分配给他。
工程师处理：李明可执行 Log progress（记录处理说明与工时）和 Submit for confirmation；提交后状态变 Pending confirmation。
回退校验：Pending confirmation 时 Return for rework 原因为空提示 “A reason is required.” 并阻止提交；填写原因后确认，工单回到 In progress 且工程师可继续处理。
关闭：主管填写 Resolution 后 Confirm and close，状态变 Closed；关闭后详情页不再显示 Log progress / Submit / Transfer / Cancel / Confirm 等操作按钮。
转派校验：Transfer ticket 的 Assignee 同样只列 4 名工程师；空 Transfer note 提示 “A transfer note is required.”；填写备注后确认，SR202609010014 被转派给刘洋并进入 In progress。
取消校验：Cancel ticket 原因为空提示 “A reason is required.”；填写原因后确认，SR202609010012 变为 Cancelled 且不再显示任何处理/转派按钮。
checks.result: 取消校验：Cancel ticket 原因为空提示 “A reason is required.”；填写原因后确认，SR202609010012 变为 Cancelled 且不再显示任何处理/转派按钮。

checks.title: 快速重复提交/关闭同一工单不产生重复业务结果；不能跳过必要状态直接关闭。
checks.criterion: 快速重复提交/关闭同一工单不产生重复业务结果；不能跳过必要状态直接关闭。
actions: 以主管登录，新建工单 SR202609220019（Pending dispatch），查看其可用操作，确认没有直接关闭入口；随后打开 Dispatch 选择李明，连续快速点击 Confirm 两次。
以工程师 svc.east@example.com 登录同一工单，Log progress 记录一次处理，再打开 Submit for confirmation 连续快速点击 Confirm 两次。
回到主管，打开 Confirm and close，填写 Resolution 后连续快速点击 Confirm 两次。
新建工单 SR202609220020，在 Pending dispatch 状态下检查操作按钮，确认不存在“直接关闭”。
刷新并逐条查看 SR202609220019 的 Activity log，核对各动作记录条数。
evidence: 重复派工幂等：连续两次点击 Dispatch 的 Confirm 后，Activity log 只有一条 “Dispatched 陈刚 1:22:05 PM”，Assignee 只分配一次，未产生重复派工。
重复提交幂等：工程师连续两次点击 Submit for confirmation 的 Confirm 后，Activity log 只有一条 “Submitted for confirmation 李明 1:22:37 PM”，未产生重复提交或重复状态。
重复关闭幂等：主管连续两次点击 Confirm and close 的 Confirm 后，Activity log 只有一条 “Confirmed and closed 陈刚 1:23:00 PM”，工单最终为 Closed，未出现重复关闭记录。
不能跳过状态：SR202609220019 在 Pending dispatch 时只显示 Dispatch / Transfer ticket / Cancel ticket，没有“直接关闭”；SR202609220020 同样只有这三个按钮，无法从草稿/待分派直接跳到已关闭。
关闭后限制：Closed 状态下不再出现 Log progress、Submit for confirmation、Confirm and close 等按钮，无法再次处理或再次关闭。
checks.result: 关闭后限制：Closed 状态下不再出现 Log progress、Submit for confirmation、Confirm and close 等按钮，无法再次处理或再次关闭。

actions: 以主管登录，在工单 /main/service/tickets/20 的附件控件中，上传测试准备提供的 5 个合法样例 sample.png、sample.pdf、sample.docx、sample.xlsx、sample.pptx，保存业务关联。
逐个点击每个附件的 Preview：PNG 检查内嵌图片像素，DOCX/XLSX/PPTX 检查渲染出的实际文档内容，PDF 通过 HAR 检查实际拉取的文件内容与浏览器查看器。
刷新工单详情页后重新打开 DOCX 预览，确认附件关联与预览仍然有效。
对 5 个附件分别点击 Download，比对下载文件与样例文件的 sha256。

evidence: 业务关联保存成功：5 个合法样例上传后，工单详情 Attachments 列表显示全部 5 个文件，每个都有 Preview/Download 按钮。
PNG 真实内容：Preview 对话框内渲染 ，取自 /main/api/service/files/.../content，natural 尺寸 32×32，对角与中心像素均为 (40,110,190,255) 纯蓝色方块，非文件名占位。
DOCX 真实内容：Preview 对话框渲染出文档文本 “Factory DOCX sample”（MIME application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document）。
XLSX 真实内容：Preview 对话框显示工作表标签 “Sample” 并渲染表格 canvas，非空白。
PPTX 真实内容：Preview 对话框渲染出文本 “Factory PPTX sample” 及幻灯片画面。

PDF 真实内容：点击 Preview 触发 GET /main/api/service/files/.../content → 200 application/pdf，随后出现 blob:http://127.0.0.1:13000/... → 200 application/pdf 及 Chrome 内置查看器 chrome-extension://mhjfbmdgcfjbbpaeojofohoefgiehjai/index.html → 200；即由浏览器本地查看器加载真实 PDF，不送第三方。无头环境对内置查看器（OOPIF）无法截图，内容以 HAR 记录与下载哈希佐证。
刷新后仍有效：reload 工单详情后 5 个附件仍在，重新点击 DOCX Preview 依旧渲染 “Factory DOCX sample”。

下载内容正确：5 个附件实际下载文件的 sha256 与 fixtures 完全一致，分别为 png=eafcdecc1468f7b18a15a7d22c494ab7e14a435f0560798ad463efc5e14f3490、pdf=6cb99aa93ea5607509fc676bf82e835728a7c44aa9f584a0974600765c0f8fc3、docx=06408d7e3a01fd82bc32240dbd035d6366ac701f50c1a90f12eb49f47288cd6e、xlsx=aebb2e45d35551150c56edd7bf7e09e46cc1423a6a99e3545c593c946f179b4e、pptx=304a16d1c38e3b7fde3accdaff511811be3200227e314c6996c7e741fe8d71cc。
损坏文件提示：上传 corrupt.png 弹出 “The file content is invalid or damaged.”，附件列表仍为 5 条，未产生半成功记录。
不支持格式提示：上传 unsupported.exe 弹出 “File type is not allowed.”，附件列表仍为 5 条。
文件样例均来自测试准备提供的 fixtures 目录，非 QA 自行生成。

obstacles.title: A seed importing application TypeScript via a .js specifier fails in the app-server test's native loader
obstacles.detail: database/main/seeds/*.ts are executed by @nocobase/db's seed loader with a native dynamic import(). Under vitest the nested relative import '../../../server/service-authorization.js' is resolved by Node's type-stripping loader, which does not rewrite .js to .ts, so tests/logic/app-server.test.ts failed with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND while `pnpm seed` (tsx) worked. tsconfig.server.json already sets allowImportingTsExtensions + rewriteRelativeImportExtensions, so the seed must import the shared model with an explicit '.ts' extension: the source resolves under Node/tsx, and tsc emits it as '.js' in dist.
obstacles.resolution: Changed the seed import to '../../../server/service-authorization.ts'. Verified the emitted dist seed imports '../../../server/service-authorization.js' and that the file exists, and that the app-server seed tests pass.
obstacles.template_suggestion: Document that files under database/ that import application source must use an explicit .ts specifier, since tsc rewrites it, while .js only works under tsx/vite and breaks the in-process app-server test.

obstacles.title: Generated database/*/collections artifacts break the factory's format:check
obstacles.detail: `pnpm collections:generate` writes collection.json/metadata.json/schema.json with expanded single-element arrays, which Prettier reformats. The factory verify.sh runs `pnpm format:check '!.github/**'`, and database/main/collections/ is not covered by .prettierignore, so format:check failed on 110 generated files. Formatting them is not an option because `pnpm collections:generate --check` compares files byte-for-byte and reports them stale.
obstacles.resolution: Added `database/*/collections/` to .prettierignore with a comment explaining it is generated output compared byte-for-byte. Verified `pnpm format:check '!.github/**'` passes and `pnpm collections:generate --check` still reports 'Up to date'.
obstacles.template_suggestion: The default template's .prettierignore should ship with `database/*/collections/` ignored, otherwise any generated app that commits Collection artifacts fails format:check.

obstacles.title: Template logic tests pin the clean-template composition
obstacles.detail: Adding app routes and an authorization plugin legitimately changed tests/logic/client-routes.test.ts, tests/logic/inspect-client.test.ts and tests/logic/config.test.ts. These tests intentionally pin route names/page grants and the authz plugin list, and the route test's componentLoader loop did not handle a navigation group route without a componentLoader.
obstacles.resolution: Updated the pinned expectations to include the service routes, page-grant names and the 'service-model' authz plugin, and made the loader check skip group routes and recurse into child routes. All 416 tests pass.

obstacles.title: The verification browser's worker containment fails closed on ES module workers
obstacles.detail: The QA/focused browser runs with AGENT_BROWSER_ALLOWED_DOMAINS + AGENT_BROWSER_CONTENT_BOUNDARIES, which wraps workers with a bootstrap. A worker created as {type:'module'} hangs (fails closed) in that environment, while an identical classic worker runs normally — including WebAssembly. The ooxml library hardcodes new Worker(url, {type:'module'}) for its render worker, so every Office preview stalled on 'Loading preview…' even though the same build rendered in a plain browser. Isolation probes confirmed: module worker + any WebAssembly access times out; classic worker + WebAssembly.validate works; no containment makes module workers work again.
obstacles.resolution: Added client/extensions/nocobase-file-component-ui/lib/ooxml-worker-compat.ts, which subclasses the native Worker and drops type:'module' only when the script URL matches the library's render-worker path, then uses mode:'worker' in createOfficeOpenXmlViewer. The render-worker bundles were verified to contain no top-level import/export or import.meta, so they are valid classic scripts. Verified under containment (docx/xlsx/pptx render canvases) and in plain Chrome (no regression).
obstacles.template_suggestion: Document that a guarded browser may fail closed on module workers and that a library hardcoding {type:'module'} needs a classic-worker fallback; the verification browser must be used for such checks, not a plain browser.

obstacles.title: An in-process app-server test cannot observe the hyphen-username fix end to end
obstacles.detail: The new assertion that a hyphenated username reaches the credential check (rather than 422 INVALID_USERNAME) returned 500 in tests/logic/app-server.test.ts because that app runs on the mocked database, and better-auth's sign-in then hits a query the mock cannot answer. The 422 path was observable because it fails validation before any query.
obstacles.resolution: Kept the existing invalid-format (space) assertion in app-server.test.ts and moved the positive hyphen case to tests/logic/service-username.test.ts, which unit-tests the exported isServiceUsername validator, plus verified the real flow (create user 201, username sign-in 200) against a migrated+seeded running app.
obstacles.template_suggestion: Prefer a unit test of the exported auth option and a real-database route check over asserting credential outcomes against the mocked app-server database.

blockers.title: Device Customer column shows the raw customer id and duplicate codes return a generic 500
blockers.symptom: Devices list rendered '1'/'6' or '—' instead of the customer name; creating/editing a device with a duplicate code returned 'API request failed (500)'.
blockers.rootCause: listDevices did not decorate rows with the customer name, and the unique-code violation was not translated so the SQL error surfaced as an unhandled 500.
blockers.resolution: listDevices (and customer device lists) now decorate customerName; saveDevice/saveCustomer detect unique violations via isUniqueViolation() and return 409 with 'Device code already exists' / 'Customer name already exists'.

blockers.title: Log progress returned 200 but persisted nothing
blockers.symptom: POST /api/service/tickets/20/actions/process returned 200 with no laborHours, notes, or log row written; transfer stored reason=null.
blockers.rootCause: transition() short-circuited any action whose target status equalled the current status as idempotent, and `process` targets in_progress while tickets are already in_progress, so the write and appendLog never ran. The transfer dialog also had no reason input.
blockers.resolution: Excluded `process` and `transfer` from the no-op shortcut, added expected['process']='in_progress' plus a terminal-status guard, require a non-empty reason for cancel/reject/transfer, and added the reason field to the client transfer dialog.
blockers.cost: 1 service + 1 client component; covered by tests/service

blockers.title: A share granted write operations to the recipient and could expose confidential tickets cross-region
blockers.symptom: A cross-region South collaborator could execute submit-confirmation on ticket 13 after a share; a confidential ticket could be shared cross-region and read by collaborator roles.
blockers.rootCause: ticketAccessible evaluated the share branch before the region/confidential checks, and there was no write-only-vs-read separation for share recipients.
blockers.resolution: Shares are read-only: ticketWritable rejects writes from share recipients, ticketAccessible ignores shares for confidential tickets, and share() rejects creating an active confidential share with 409. Added tests for the hidden shared-confidential ticket and the write matrix.
blockers.cost: 1 authz file + 6 tests added to tests/service/ticket-access.test.ts

blockers.title: Office previews did nothing for XLSX and corrupt/unsupported files were silently accepted or dropped
blockers.symptom: DOCX/PPTX previewed but XLSX showed nothing; a corrupt PNG uploaded with no error; an .exe was silently dropped; no download control existed.
blockers.rootCause: The Rust/WASM XLSX parser requires xl/styles.xml, which a minimal spreadsheet omits, so viewer.load threw; upload validation did not decode images and rejected unsupported extensions without surfacing a message; the preview field had no download affordance.
blockers.resolution: Added a try-then-patch XLSX fallback that injects a minimal xl/styles.xml via fflate only after load fails, an image decode check that rejects damaged files with a visible error, toast surfacing through FileAttachments.handleError, and a per-file download button routed through resolveSafeFileUrl.
blockers.cost: 1 devDependency (fflate); browser-confirmed original error vs patched render; tests/components/file-preview.test.tsx re-run

blockers.title: Creating a user always returned HTTP 500
blockers.symptom: POST /api/users failed with 500 for a valid payload while missing-field validations correctly returned 400.
blockers.rootCause: better-auth@1.7.5's account schema does not declare `issuer`, but NocoBase's authentication migration created account.issuer NOT NULL, so the insert failed on the missing column.
blockers.resolution: Declared account.additionalFields.issuer (required, defaultValue 'local:credential') in server/config/auth.ts; verified a real user create/disable/enable cycle.
blockers.cost: 1 config file; diagnostic users deleted after verification

blockers.title: Dispatching a ticket produced no persistent in-app message
blockers.symptom: The message center stayed empty and no unread count appeared after dispatch.
blockers.rootCause: The notification configuration shipped without an in-app database channel, so notifyUser() had no provider to persist to.
blockers.resolution: server/config/notification.ts now defaults to an enabled in-app channel backed by the default database provider; an explicit configuration still overrides it. notifyUser() returns whether delivery was recorded so callers can act on it.

blockers.title: Auto-acceptance execution records were never written or reachable
blockers.symptom: serviceAutomationRuns existed but was unused; every guessed API path and page returned 404/empty.
blockers.rootCause: No service or route existed to record or read auto-acceptance runs, and no page exposed them.
blockers.resolution: Added AutomationService (runAcceptance/resolveRoute/listRuns/retry), wired it into submit/create-with-submit/integration, exposed scoped runs + retry + inspection plan/run endpoints, added the /service/automation page, nav entry and page grant, and added the serviceJobRuns migration for inspection-plan run history with enable/disable and run-now controls.
blockers.cost: 1 new migration (202609220105) applied + collections regenerated; 1 new service, page and route group

blockers.title: pnpm 11 prints an install summary on stdout before `pnpm exec`, breaking a JSON-parsing test
blockers.symptom: tests/logic/inspect-client.test.ts failed with `SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'A', "Already up"... is not valid JSON` because `pnpm exec tsx` emitted 'Already up to date / Done in ...' before the JSON payload.
blockers.rootCause: pnpm 11's verifyDepsBeforeRun default runs a dependency install before every exec/run and writes its summary to stdout; the factory already installs with --frozen-lockfile, so the extra run is redundant.
blockers.resolution: Set verifyDepsBeforeRun: false in pnpm-workspace.yaml with an explanatory comment. The test's assertion is unchanged; its stdout is now the command's JSON alone.
blockers.cost: 1 config line; inspect-client + full suite re-run

blockers.title: Device edit form showed the raw customer id and a duplicate code edit returned 500
blockers.symptom: The Customer select rendered '7' instead of the customer name; editing an existing device onto an already-used code returned only 'API request failed (500)' while create returned a generic 'API request failed (409)'.
blockers.rootCause: The application uses Base UI Select (@base-ui/react/select), not Radix: Select.Value resolves a label only from the `items` prop on Select.Root and never reads mounted SelectItem children, so without `items` it falls back to the raw value. Separately, saveDevice checked duplicates on create but not on update, where the unique constraint surfaced as a driver error (500); the business message in the `{ errors: [{ message }] }` envelope was not read by the page's error handling.
blockers.resolution: Added the `items` prop to the device customer and region Selects (and any select whose label is not its value). saveDevice now checks the code once for both paths, excluding the edited row with `where('id','!=',input.id)`, and translates a raced constraint violation to ServiceRuleError('Device code already exists', 409). The client's ServiceClient rethrows the server business message via a serviceErrorMessage() helper that reads payload.errors[0].message with { cause } attached.
blockers.cost: 1 client page + 1 client lib + 1 server service; tests/service/catalog-devices.test.ts and tests/logic/service-api.test.ts added

blockers.title: Message-center Open link missed the deployment base path and stayed stale after reconnect
blockers.symptom: Clicking a notification's Open link navigated to /service/tickets/<id> (missing /main) and showed JSON {"error":"Not found"}; messages that arrived while the socket was offline only appeared after a manual reload or window focus.
blockers.rootCause: The inbox stored route-internal actionUrl values (/service/tickets/<id>) that were rendered as a raw <a href>, bypassing the router basename, and the page subscribed only to window focus events.
blockers.resolution: Internal actionUrl values now render through react-router's Link (so basename /main is applied), while absolute http(s) URLs keep an external anchor. The page subscribes with subscribeToInboxInvalidations(realtime, window, reload) from @nocobase/app-plugin-notification-in-app/client, which refetches on the inbox.changed topic and on realtime reopen, and additionally listens for the browser 'online' event.

blockers.title: The transfer/dispatch selector listed every user, and transferring to a read-only observer stuck the ticket
blockers.symptom: On a pending_dispatch ticket the Transfer dialog offered svc-observer (read-only) and svc-collab/svc-integration; transferring ticket 12 to svc-observer returned 200, set the assignee and moved the ticket to in_progress, but the observer cannot process it, so the ticket had no actionable assignee.
blockers.rootCause: listMembers returned every serviceMembers row with no capability indicator, and TicketService.transition() set assigneeId for assign/transfer without checking that the target can process tickets.
blockers.resolution: Added canProcessTickets() (resolves authorization subjects and checks service.tickets:process) and isAssignableRegion() ['east','south','north','west'] in server/services/service-auth.ts; listMembers now returns a per-row assignable flag; the client assignee select filters assignable === true (share/team selectors keep the full list); transition() rejects a non-assignable assign/transfer target with ServiceRuleError('The selected user cannot process tickets', 400). Verified: observer transfer 400, engineer transfer 200.
blockers.cost: 2 server services + 1 client lib + 1 client component + tests/service/ticket-access.test.ts cases

blockers.title: Office/PDF in-app preview was blank or hung on 'Loading preview…'
blockers.symptom: In the verification browser, DOCX/XLSX/PPTX previews stayed on 'Loading preview…' or blank; the same build rendered correctly in a plain Chrome launched by Playwright.
blockers.rootCause: The browser's worker containment fails closed on ES module workers, and @silurus/ooxml creates its render worker with {type:'module'}. (PDF was separately confirmed healthy: the native blob iframe loads the Chrome PDF viewer, even under the allowlist; the QA PDF screenshot was an about:blank artifact.)
blockers.resolution: Added the scoped classic-worker shim and switched createOfficeOpenXmlViewer to mode:'worker'. Verified under containment: docx canvas 823x1065 'Factory DOCX sample', pptx 823x463, xlsx 870x413; plain Chrome renders all four formats including the PDF blob iframe.

blockers.title: Admin could not create users, and username sign-in rejected the application's own accounts
blockers.symptom: POST /api/users with a valid payload returned 500 'Internal Server Error'; username sign-in for seeded accounts such as svc-observer returned 422 INVALID_USERNAME (only email sign-in and the admin 'nocobase' username worked).
blockers.rootCause: better-auth's default username validator is /^[a-zA-Z0-9_.]+$/, which rejects the hyphens every account in this application uses; the Users plugin's error handler lacks an APIError branch, so the rejection surfaced as 500 on create and 422 on sign-in.
blockers.resolution: Exported isServiceUsername (/^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+$/) from server/config/auth.ts and passed it as better-auth's usernameValidator. Verified on a migrated+seeded running app: svc-admin username sign-in 200; POST /api/users for qa-verify-user 201; qa-verify-user username sign-in 200.

blockers.title: The submit-confirmation dialog title showed the raw i18n key
blockers.symptom: The confirmation modal heading read 'service.ticketActions.submit-confirmation' in both English and Chinese.
blockers.rootCause: ticket-actions.tsx built the title with a template literal t(`service.ticketActions.${action}`) while the locale uses camelCase keys (submitConfirmation), so the hyphenated action id had no message.
blockers.resolution: Added a typed ACTION_TITLE_KEY map from each ActionKind to its locale key and used t(ACTION_TITLE_KEY[action]). Verified in the browser: the dialog now shows 'Submit for confirmation'.

improvements.title: Browser checks should assert previewed content, not just a Preview control
improvements.detail: The Office fixtures that 'did nothing' still passed a presence-only check: the button existed, so the failure was only visible when the rendered content was inspected. The XLSX fixture was a minimal OOXML archive that the parser rejected for a missing xl/styles.xml, which a click-only check cannot catch.
improvements.suggestedChange: For each Office fixture, wait for the preview surface and assert non-empty rendered text/HTML; add a corrupt fixture that must show an error and an unsupported fixture that must show a rejection.

improvements.title: Ship the better-auth account.issuer field with the authentication defaults
improvements.detail: NocoBase's authentication migration creates account.issuer NOT NULL, but better-auth@1.7.5 does not declare it, so user creation 500s until an application adds additionalFields.issuer. Every app hits this the first time it creates a user.
improvements.suggestedChange: Add the account.issuer additionalField to the template's server/config/auth.ts (or the authentication plugin's default schema) so a fresh app can create users without an override.

improvements.title: Default the notification configuration to an in-app database channel
improvements.detail: Without a channel, notifyUser() silently succeeds with nothing persisted, so dispatch/reject notices never reach the inbox. Applications must otherwise discover by hand that they need to add the channel.
improvements.suggestedChange: Make the in-app/database channel the code-level default of the notification configuration, overridable by an explicit channel list, and have notifyUser() report delivery so a missing channel is observable.

improvements.title: Decide verifyDepsBeforeRun explicitly in the scaffold
improvements.detail: pnpm 11 runs a dependency install before exec/run by default and writes its summary to stdout, which silently breaks any command (like the client-inspect command test) that parses its own stdout as JSON.
improvements.suggestedChange: Ship verifyDepsBeforeRun: false in pnpm-workspace.yaml, or have tests strip leading non-JSON lines before parsing.

improvements.title: Document the OOXML parser's required parts for minimal files
improvements.detail: The bundled XLSX viewer requires xl/styles.xml and fails on otherwise-valid minimal workbooks, producing a 'preview does nothing' symptom that looks like a UI bug.
improvements.suggestedChange: Note the required-part behavior in the file/preview guidance and keep the inject-a-minimal-styles fallback as the reference fix.

improvements.title: Share semantics need a read-only-vs-write test at the authorization layer
improvements.detail: A share path that granted recipient writes to a confidential cross-region ticket was not covered, so the browser QA discovered it as a security regression rather than the unit layer.
improvements.suggestedChange: Add ticket-share authorization tests covering read-only recipients, confidential tickets, and cross-region writes as part of the module's seeded tests.

improvements.title: Document that Base UI Select labels require an items prop
improvements.detail: Unlike Radix, Base UI's Select.Value resolves the trigger label from the `items` prop on Select.Root and ignores mounted SelectItem children, so a select with no `items` silently displays the raw value (an id) instead of its label. This shipped in the devices customer/region selects and is easy to reintroduce.
improvements.suggestedChange: Note in the components/styling guidance that every Base UI Select passes `items` when its value differs from its display label, and prefer a test that asserts the visible label over the raw value.

improvements.title: Office preview checks must run under the verification browser's containment
improvements.detail: The broken Office previews rendered perfectly in a plain Playwright browser; only the guarded verification browser exposed the module-worker hang. A presence-only or plain-browser check would have kept passing the defect.
improvements.suggestedChange: Run the attachment-preview acceptance with the same worker containment the QA harness uses, and assert rendered canvas or text for each Office format.

improvements.title: Broaden the better-auth username validator in the template auth defaults
improvements.detail: The template seeds and the Users page issue hyphenated usernames, but better-auth's default validator excludes '-', so every user create and hyphenated sign-in fails until the application overrides usernameValidator.
improvements.suggestedChange: Ship a hyphen-permitting usernameValidator (or align seeded usernames) in the template's server/config/auth.ts.

improvements.title: Assign/dispatch pickers must filter by the process capability, not by membership
improvements.detail: Any member list offered as a ticket assignee can include observers, collaborators and integration accounts that cannot process tickets; choosing one succeeds and strands the ticket.
improvements.suggestedChange: Expose an assignable flag computed from the tickets:process permission and a concrete service region, filter the assignee picker by it, and re-validate the target server-side in the transition.

improvements.title: Derive dialog titles from a typed action map, not the action id
improvements.detail: Interpolating an action id into a translation key silently produces a raw key whenever the id (submit-confirmation) and the locale key (submitConfirmation) diverge.
improvements.suggestedChange: Map each action to its locale key explicitly (typed Record<ActionKind, string>) and add a test that every ActionKind resolves to a defined message.

delivery.acceptanceRequirements:
以下仅为业务浏览器验收。逐条记录实际操作、观察、证据；模块代码/Skill 检查见独立评审评论，不能用页面通过代替代码评审，也不能要求浏览器 QA 伪造源码证据。

B01. 以主管、华东工程师、华南工程师、协作工程师、观察员分别登录，验证各自入口及允许/禁止的业务操作；角色切换不保留前一账号的权限。
B02. 新增客户和设备、编辑后刷新，验证值回填与保存；重复设备编号、无效客户设备关联有清晰反馈。
B03. 搜索、区域/状态筛选、分页、详情刷新和返回列表正常，结果不能混入无权访问的记录。
B04. 按草稿、提交、分派、处理、待确认、退回、再次处理、关闭跑通一张工单；验证转派/取消原因和关闭后的限制。
B05. 快速重复提交/关闭同一工单不产生重复业务结果；不能跳过必要状态直接关闭。
B06. 实际上传 PNG、PDF、DOCX、XLSX、PPTX 小型合法文件并保存业务关联；逐格式检查显示的内容而非文件名，刷新后重新预览、下载；损坏或不支持的文件给出失败提示。文件测试样例由测试准备生成或提供，不能把浏览器 QA 自行生成文件当成浏览器操作。
B07. 用无工单访问权的普通用户尝试打开工单及其附件，不能显示内容；观察员看不到内部成本字段且不能编辑。
B08. 默认知识可读范围、指定工单跨区分享、分享撤销、保密限制分别生效；分享不能自动授予原本没有的操作。
B09. 分派后收件人消息中心出现对应持久消息，可跳转、已读/未读、删除；刷新/重新登录后状态正确，其他用户看不到；断开再恢复连接后可补齐消息。
B10. 保存成功、必填校验和一次真实失败都有正确的即时反馈，失败后未保存内容可恢复，不以 toast 冒充站内信。
B11. 从自动受理的执行记录查看步骤与实际工单结果；失败场景保留失败原因，恢复不删除旧记录或重复通知。
B12. 管理员查看巡检/超期计划，使用测试环境提供的短周期或受控触发观察实际执行；执行结束时业务结果一致，重复执行不重复创建当天巡检；停用后不再产生新任务。
B13. 看板数值与当前用户能看到的工单一致，状态变更和筛选后更新；不同岗位不出现越权统计。
B14. 管理员创建、停用、重新启用测试用户并维护岗位；停用后的原会话不可继续使用，其他业务账户不受影响。只读业务管理员可查看数据结构，但不能改表。
B15. 切换中英文，逐页检查导航、字段、弹窗、文件组件、消息及错误反馈；刷新/直接地址访问正常，不能只有中文静态页面。
B16. 服务助手未配置时准确提示且手工流程正常；配置测试模型的扩展轮次才验证真实问答、上下文范围、建议草稿、确认/拒绝和对话恢复。外部通知同理：没有测试服务标为扩展场景未执行，不声称实投成功。

API 密钥的 HTTP 调用、服务端越权/幂等、代码边界、安装引导和 Hub 发布属于独立集成/模块评审，不将它们冒充浏览器截图验收。测试角色账号可通过管理员 UI 创建，统一使用本轮测试密码配置；测试准备缺失、基础环境失败与真实业务缺陷分别报告。
